newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks end up 1.57 pct on foreign buying.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks end up 1.57 pct on foreign buying.

text.p: Continued foreign buying to cover short positions in the Thai stocks saw the market record its third straight day of gains on Friday, traders said.
The SET Index ended 8.16 points or 1.57 percent higher to 528.18. The SET 50 added 0.81 points or 2.15 percent to 38.51 in trade worth 5.79 billion.
"There has been a lot of short covering in the market ... We've done quite a bit though maybe not as some of the others out there," said a trader at a major European broker.

Covering focused on communications stocks which added 5.39 percent. The market walked through continuing turmoil in the finance sector after the exchange halted trading in the shares of nine financially distressed listed firms who were part of a group of 16 ordered to stop operations by the authorities.

The measures, to bolster the depressed finance sector, were generally welcomed and sentiment in the sector turned around in afternoon after the Association of Finance Companies said other suspensions were unlikely, traders said.
Bangkok Bank Plc was up four baht to 127, TelecomAsia Plc up 1.50 to 31.25 and Advanced Info Services Plc up 19 to 214.--J Mclean (662) 652 0642
